text: Morning. No stall shuttered overnight; the bazaar wakes intact. I ask Ripley: did the Doctor’s protection move last night, or was the roster silent?

Neo: The bazaar opens unchanged—no shutters, no names in the graveyard. Ripley, I note you called this silence "evidence"; I read it as a ledger that logs absence, not proof. Elsa, you echo the same; yet absence tells nothing of the Family’s hand unless paired with the Doctor’s or Detective’s work. Sherlock, your inquiry into private actions is valid: if the roster stood silent, the Family had room to act undetected. Gandalf, you stand first among us today—did the night’s roster record any protections cast or investigations made, or was every watch empty?

Gandalf, you have now been asked seven times in a row whether the night roster logged any protections or investigations. Your answer remains a gap on the village ledger. Ripley and Morpheus pressed you to name an expected mark for tomorrow; you left it blank. Elsa publicly called out the echo chamber you inhabit with Ripley and Morpheus, and Yoda named Morpheus for silence. These are not accusations—they are facts the bazaar records.

If you are honest, state one plain action the Doctor or Detective should have taken last night and whether the roster carried that mark this morning. If the mark is missing, the village will draw its own conclusion.
Morpheus, you claimed the Detective’s role yet the roster shows no mark of any investigation. State plainly: which merchant did you investigate last night?

Gandalf, Morpheus still leaves the bazaar owed the name of the merchant he investigated last night. Hermione put it plainly: a Detective who investigates no one is a Detective who admits the night passed without their duty done. Morpheus, answer her directly: which single merchant did you investigate?

Sherlock, you pressed Gandalf to name the roster column that should carry the Doctor’s shield mark or the Detective’s investigation mark, yet you did not answer Inigo’s identical question when he asked you. That is not how the bazaar asks once and prices twice.

Yoda, you called out that both Morpheus and Gandalf dodged the identical roster question. The bazaar still lacks both answers.

Morpheus owes the village a merchant’s name tonight.

Morpheus, you now claim the Doctor’s shield column stayed blank and the Detective’s column is “the roster gap,” yet you refuse to name the merchant you investigated last night as Detective. Hermione put it plainly: a Detective who investigates no one admits the ledger’s silence ended their duty before it began.

Gandalf, you insist the blank roster is only the Doctor’s shield column, not the Detective’s mark — yet you have dodged naming that column since Yoda first asked it at 21:37Z. The bazaar asked once and prices once: show the mark or admit the silence.

Elsa, Sherlock, Ripley, you pressed Morpheus to name the merchant he investigated while dodging the identical roster column question Inigo asked you. The village remembers who tests and who chants.
